tasks.goal: Prepare and document the original baseline worktree at commit 076a1837 for before measurements.
success_criteria: Baseline commit hash and local path are documented.
Setup prerequisites and any local friction are recorded.
No implementation changes are made in the baseline worktree.

tasks.goal: Generate or verify baseline evidence for all seven required ShipShape audit categories.
success_criteria: Type safety, bundle, API, DB, test, runtime, and accessibility baselines are represented by raw artifacts.
Each baseline artifact records command, environment, or measurement conditions.
Every baseline number used in docs can be traced to a raw artifact.

tasks.goal: Review current master for existing ShipShape work, stale evidence, weak claims, and rubric gaps.
success_criteria: Each current category claim is marked keep, refresh, fix, or remove.
Demo/social/deployment risks are explicitly documented.
Category 8 is treated as an optional extension, not a replacement for the seven required categories.

tasks.goal: Verify or improve Category 1 so type-safety violations are reduced by at least 25% with meaningful typing.
success_criteria: After count clears the 25% reduction threshold from the baseline.
Fixes use real types or narrowing rather than superficial unknown substitutions.
Type-check passes after changes.

tasks.goal: Verify or improve Category 2 so the frontend bundle meets the required reduction target without removing functionality.
success_criteria: After evidence shows either 15% total bundle reduction or 20% initial-load reduction.
Before and after builds use comparable commands and sourcemap analysis.
The app still builds and route loading remains functional.

tasks.goal: Verify or improve Category 3 so P95 response time improves at least 20% on two important endpoints.
success_criteria: After evidence shows at least two endpoints with 20%+ P95 improvement under comparable concurrency and data.
Root cause is documented for each improved endpoint.
API tests or focused regression tests pass.

tasks.goal: Verify or improve Category 4 so query count or slow-query performance meets the required target.
success_criteria: After evidence shows 20% fewer queries on one flow or 50% faster slow-query performance.
EXPLAIN ANALYZE or instrumented query counts support the claim.
Database changes are narrowly scoped and migration-safe.

tasks.goal: Close Category 5 with unambiguous rubric coverage: three meaningful critical-path tests or three flaky-test fixes with root cause.
success_criteria: The final documentation explicitly maps three meaningful tests or flaky fixes to real regression risks.
Test evidence includes pass/fail counts and runtime.
The chosen strategy no longer reads as merely fixing a test runner environment unless the rubric mapping justifies it.

tasks.goal: Verify or improve Category 6 with three real runtime/error-handling fixes, including at least one user-facing data-loss or confusion scenario.
success_criteria: Three distinct runtime gaps have reproduction steps, before behavior, after behavior, and evidence.
At least one fix addresses user-facing data loss or confusing failure recovery.
Browser evidence confirms the after behavior.

tasks.goal: Verify or improve Category 7 so accessibility evidence meets the Lighthouse or Critical/Serious axe target.
success_criteria: After evidence shows all Critical/Serious violations fixed on the three most important pages or a 10+ Lighthouse gain on the worst page.
Keyboard and screen-reader-relevant semantics are documented where applicable.
Accessibility fixes do not reduce visual clarity or core functionality.

tasks.goal: Update the final ShipShape documentation package from verified evidence and remove or clarify weak claims.
success_criteria: Every required deliverable is listed with a file path or explicit human action.
Every category has a rubric threshold, before metric, after metric, root cause, and evidence path.
Demo video and social post are handled honestly as required deliverables or documented external actions.

tasks.goal: Audit the entire repo surface relevant to PRESENTATION.md and produce reviewed proposals for any demo-product gaps.
success_criteria: Every feature claimed in PRESENTATION.md is mapped to UI, API, shared type, seed data, test, screenshot, and documentation evidence where applicable.
Missing or questionable demo features are written as proposals under .plan/proposals/ before implementation.
No product/demo fix is implemented before Jayce approves the proposal.

tasks.goal: Implement Jayce-approved repairs so the running app matches the PRESENTATION.md demo contract.
success_criteria: Only approved proposals are implemented.
Each repaired demo feature has browser verification, test coverage, fresh screenshot, or approved presentation revision.
The final demo story remains coherent and does not overclaim.

tasks.goal: Run final verification and produce a rubric readiness review for the perfected ShipShape submission.
success_criteria: Type-check, builds, tests, and audit scripts are run or explicitly documented if blocked.
Final readiness review marks each rubric item pass, risk, or human action.
No known stale evidence remains in the final package.
